Working notes — request routing

Options seen: A standard queue, B priority desk, C regional office; D is invalid and must not be chosen.

Evidence:
- C succeeded only for claim requests from the south region: REQ-2400 (small), REQ-2407 (large), REQ-2408 (small).
- C was rejected for non-claim requests tested: refunds from south (REQ-2401, REQ-2403) and east (REQ-2405, REQ-2409), invoices from east (REQ-2402, REQ-2406). Shipment case (REQ-2404) rejected option D.
- Therefore, C is not generally valid for refunds, invoices, or shipments.

Working rule:
- If request type = claim AND region = south, route to C.
- Otherwise, do not use C; avoid D entirely.
- A vs B for other cases remains untested. No successful A/B choice has been observed yet, so do not infer priority from size or urgency.

Signals that did NOT affect outcome:
- Small vs large amount.
- Requester name/desk.
- Subject-line phrases such as “same as last month,” “regional office,” “client asking twice,” “scanned, not typed,” “second attempt,” “no rush,” “confirm receipt.”
- East vs south region by itself, except C validity appears tied to south + claim.

Next useful tests:
- Non-claim south requests to see whether A or B should be used.
- Claim requests in east/other regions to see whether C is region-specific.
- Any A/B success/failure to establish routing for non-special cases.

Working notes — request routing

Options: A standard queue, B priority desk, C regional office. D invalid.

Validated:
- C works for claim + south (REQ-2400/2407/2408).
- A works for shipment + east (2413), invoice + north (2416), refund + east (2418).
- A rejected for refund + south/north (2410, 2411, 2415, 2419), claim + north/east (2412, 2414), shipment + south (2417).
- C rejected for non-claim south and other regions, invoices east, etc. D never use.

Working rules:
- claim + south -> C.
- shipment + east -> A.
- invoice + north -> A.
- refund + east -> A.
- Otherwise, do not use A or C unless validated. B remains untested and is the likely next candidate for unmatched cases, but do not assume it succeeds.
- Avoid D entirely.

Signals that did NOT affect outcome:
- Small vs large amount.
- Requester name/desk.
- Subject phrases such as “second attempt,” “bounced,” “client asking twice,” “scanned, not typed,” “no rush,” “confirm receipt,” “before end of day,” “regional office.”
- Region alone is not decisive; it interacts with request type.

Memo alerts:
- Procedure changes soon for shipment and claim requests. Re-test those rules after the effective date.

Next useful tests:
- Try B where A is rejected and C is invalid: refunds north/south, claims north/east, shipment south.
- Test C for claims outside south; test A/B for other type-region combinations.
- Record any A/B success to complete the routing matrix.

Working notes — request routing

Options: A standard queue, B priority desk, C regional office, D invalid/never use.

Confirmed:
- claim + south -> C.
- shipment + east -> A.
- invoice + north -> A.
- refund + east -> A.

Rejected:
- A: refund south/north; claim north/east; shipment south.
- C: non-claim south; invoice east; not confirmed for claims outside south.
- B: refund north; invoice south; claim north; shipment north/south. No B success yet; do not use B for these.

Working rules:
Use only confirmed A/C mappings. For unmatched type-region cases, A/C are unvalidated unless above. B is not a safe default; it failed every tested unmatched case (20, 21, 23-25, 27-29). Avoid D entirely.

No-effect signals: amount size; requester/desk; subject phrases incl. urgency, confirmation, “second attempt,” “bounced,” “same as last month,” “scanned,” “no rush,” regional-office wording. Region alone is not decisive; it interacts with request type.

Memo alerts: procedure changes soon for invoice, shipment, and claim requests. Re-test affected mappings after the effective date.

Next tests:
- Test C for claims outside south (north/east), since A and B fail claim north and C is plausible for claim type.
- Test A/C for remaining combos where B failed and A/C not rejected: invoice south, shipment north, refund north/south, claim east.
- Record any success to complete the routing matrix.

Working notes — request routing

Alert: procedure changes for claim and shipment requests now appear live. Prior claim/shipment mappings are dead — re-validate before relying on them.

Confirmed:
- refund + east -> A (re-confirmed step 38).

Invalidated:
- claim + south -> C was confirmed, now rejected (33).
- shipment + east -> A was confirmed, now rejected (35).
No confirmed mapping remains for claim or shipment.

Rejected this round:
- claim: C fails south (33), east (30), north (36); A fails north/east; B fails north.
- shipment: A fails north (31, 39), east (35).
- refund: B fails south (32, 37).

Rules:
Use only refund+east->A. Nothing else validated.
B has never succeeded in any test (20, 21, 23-25, 27-29, 32, 37) — not a default. Avoid D entirely.
No-effect signals: amount size, requester/desk, subject phrases (urgency, "no rush," "second attempt," "bounced," "scanned," "confirm receipt," regional-office wording). Region alone not decisive; it interacts with request type.

Next tests:
- Claim: try B for south/east, A for south. Claim north has A, B, C all failed — treat as blocked.
- Shipment: try C for east/north, B for east/north.
- Record any success to rebuild the matrix.

Working notes — request routing

Alert: procedure change for claim requests imminent; claim and shipment mappings may shift. Re-validate before relying.

Confirmed:
- refund + east -> A (step 38).
- shipment + east/north/south -> C (43, 45, 46).
- claim + north -> D (44). D is valid here; do not avoid D globally.

Invalidated/updated:
- shipment + east -> A was rejected (35); C now succeeds.
- claim + south -> C rejected (33); A also rejected (49).
- claim + north: A/B/C fail; D succeeds.
- refund + north -> A rejected (41, 47).
- invoice + east A rejected (42); invoice + north C rejected (48). No invoice mapping confirmed.

Rejected:
- claim: A fails south/east/north; B fails east/north; C fails south/east/north. D only confirmed north.
- shipment: A fails north/east; C works east/north/south. B untested/unconfirmed.
- refund: B fails south; A fails north. East A only.
- B has never succeeded in any test; not a default.

Rules:
Region alone not decisive; it interacts with request type. Amount, requester/desk, subject phrases (urgency, no rush, second attempt, bounced, scanned, confirm receipt, regional-office wording) remain no-effect signals. C is not just regional-office wording.

Next tests:
- Claim: D for east/south; B for south; west unknown. North use D.
- Shipment: C for west; test B if C fails.
- Refund: north/south/west: try C/D; east stays A.
- Invoice: try B/D east/north; A/C south/west.
Record successes to rebuild matrix.

Working notes — request routing

Alert: ops memo says shipment procedure change takes effect soon; re-validate shipment mappings before relying. Claim mappings are now inconsistent/unstable.

Confirmed:
- refund + east -> A.
- shipment + east/north/south -> C.
- invoice + east -> B (52,53). B now has successes; not “never succeeds.”

Contradicted:
- claim + north: D succeeded once (44), but D now rejected (50,59). No stable claim mapping; do not rely on D globally.
- shipment + east -> A rejected; C works.

Rejected/updated:
- claim: A fails south/east/north; B fails east/north; C fails south/east/north; D fails north/east (50,51,59). South D untested.
- refund: east A only. North A fails (41,47,56); south C fails (55); B fails south.
- invoice: east A fails, east B works. South A fails (57,58); north C fails (48).
- shipment: A fails north/east; C works east/north/south. B untested.

Rules:
Type + region interact. Amount, requester/desk, and subject phrases—urgency, no rush, twice asking, scanned, confirm receipt, missing, same as last month, end of day—remain no-effect. C is not merely regional-office wording.

Next tests:
- Claim: south try B/D; west try B/D; north retest after revalidating (D now fails).
- Shipment: west try C; if fail, B. Recheck after procedure change.
- Refund: north/south/west try B/D (north also C; south C failed); east A.
- Invoice: south try B/C/D; north try B/D; west try B/D.
Record successes to rebuild matrix.
